summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Half-Year Report to 30 June 2026, as a routine periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer. The report covers interim results, segment revenue trends, New Categories growth, and reiterates FY26 guidance. It also notes a share buy-back programme on track for £1.3 billion in 2026, which is an ongoing capital return initiative rather than a discrete special-situation event. No acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, or other transformative transactions are announced. This is an ordinary earnings release, not a special situation.
